@everyone Here is July 17, In the Year of Our King 1632           

Dear Diary, 

My name is Wren Rosewood and I am twelve years old. I wanted to introduce myself since we will be talking a lot from now on. Let me tell you more about me. 

My parents' names are Peya and Reito, we live in a small village called Sevenoaks in Britain. I am an only child and used to be my father's apprentice. My father, Reito, was the hunter for our village for the past 20 years. I trained a lot and now I have been named the Hunter Of Sevenoaks. It is quite a shame though, since I am leaving. 

My Mother gave me this journal in the hopes that I will document my journey to London, across the ocean, to the New World. I am SOOOO excited! It is currently the night before I leave and I cannot sleep. I am using a candle I have saved to cast some light so that I may write some more. 

My Father wants me to use this to write about all of the different species of flora and fauna that I find on my travels, but, while I will do that a little bit, I want to draw and write adventures. I want to talk about all the cool things I did! Not just focus on what plants I can eat without getting sick. 

Ok diary, I should probably sign off for the night, my candle is shrinking and I think I heard my mother coming up the stairs.
Goodnight!
